newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy May 10-12 diesel, kero.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy May 10-12 diesel, kero.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 85,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 60,000 barrels of illuminating kerosene for May 10-12 delivery, a CPC source said on Monday.
The combination cargo is for delivery to Trincomalee on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender closes on April 23 and offers are valid for two days.

In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought from French oil firm Total 220,000 barrels of diesel and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel, both at eight cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f Colombo, for May 5-6 delivery.
